ios.desc:
ParkAround is the #1 app that finds you a spot in the city of Athens, in the airports of Athens, Barcelona, Thessaloniki, Heraklion, Rhodes, Chania and Larnaca as well as Piraeus and Volos Port.

ParkAround has partnered with over 200 car parks in Greece and & Spain and has secured exclusive discounts up to 80% for you if you book through the app.

Using the ParkAround app, you can find parking near an address, an area or even a place, enter your parking dates/duration and get a cost estimate and compare all available car parks to find the one that fits you best.

Booking a spot is quick, easy and FREE!

Skip wasting time try to find and a parking spot and let ParkAround find the spot for you.

Join ParkAround today!

Note: Continued use of GPS may dramatically decrease battery life
